cost_reduction_idea: Stop asking the model to emit line_total per line item -- it's pure arithmetic (quantity * unit_price), already computed in Python by generate_docs.py/known from the two other fields, and costs real output tokens for no accuracy benefit (an LLM's multiplication isn't more trustworthy than code doing it directly). At 10.4 line items/doc average in this run, that's a meaningful fraction of the ~10 extra numeric tokens per document going toward a field the pipeline could derive itself post-hoc instead of paying the model to produce it -- proportionally larger for the longer multi-page invoices (this run's worst case had 35 line items) where output-token cost scales with item count.
